patthana13.11:2.1: asekkhaṁ → pañca asekhaṁ (bj); pañca nevasekkhānāsekkhaṁ (sya-all) | nanevasekkhanāsekkho → na nevasekho nāsekho (bj); na asekkho (sya-all)
patthana13.11:3.1: nevasekkhanāsekkhaṁ → neva sekha na asekhaṁ (bj); neva sekhā nāsekhaṁ (bj); tīṇi sekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca (sya-all); sekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca (sya-all)
patthana13.11:4.1: sekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca → tīṇi asekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca (sya-all); asekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca (sya-all)
patthana13.11:5.1: asekkhañca nevasekkhanāsekkhañca → asekhañca nevasekhā na asekhañca (bj) | uppajjanti → uppajjati (bj)
